Correspondence of Erna and Adolf Rosenberg

Included: birth and death certificate of Erich Hermann Steinberg; copy of the birth certificate amended to add: ‘Erich Hermann Steinberg additionally bears the given name Israel’; photographs of Ralph Rosenberg's wedding with menu; greetings from the Bahamas; postcards from Paris, Miami Beach, Tel Aviv, Ischia (Italy), and Lake Placid; WMF brochure; letter on Queen Mary letterhead; Season's Greetings.

Contains: correspondence with Erna Rosenberg about the status of individual restitution matters and private affairs; newspaper articles from AUFBAU of 8 January 1954: Alfred Prager, ‘Restitution. Why the compensation law must be amended,’ and ‘10,000 blocked marks released. Further easing of the transfer regulations’; circular letter from attorney Henry Mayer concerning the transfer of proceeds, payments, and restitution benefits; telegrams; customer letter from Adolf Rosenberg about the sale of his company Stabilized Vitamins; travel plans for trips to Europe and Israel.
